data.said: The pre-merge review came back **FAIL**, and it was right. That changed the session materially. ## What the review caught **1. Authorization (critical).** `handler.ts` derives `role` from the **URL path**, which proves nothing about the caller. All roles share one Cognito pool, `/customer/auth/{proxy+}` has no gateway authoriser, and `GetUser` succeeds for any valid token — so reaching `case 'delete-account'` under a `/customer/…` URL only meant the caller *typed* "customer". A vendor or commissioner could have irreversibly deleted their own Cognito login, and because the anonymize lane finds no `customers` row for them it returned `ignored` and my code **deleted the login while erasing nothing**, orphaning their real record. Federated accounts were worse: they skip the password block, so a valid bearer alone sufficed. I verified this myself before acting. The decisive evidence is `register.ts:163-166` — *"Authorization uses Cognito group membership"* — which my handler never consulted.
